comment: The PLY knob is configured 1 to 7 (Modulator7.cpp:125) and its lowest position is printed 'c' on the panel; at that setting Modulator7.cpp:582-589 sends a single-channel 1ms pulse on each main-rate cycle rather than a bundle of oscillators. The RST output is a plain reset thru: a 1ms pulse whenever the button or the jack resets the module. The census gives the seven oscillator outputs empty names because Modulator7.cpp:134 configures them with an empty string. The xRate presets are ten separate menu items rather than a submenu.
